name: Dominic Santiago — Campagne Gears of War 2
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE static transparent full-body costume reference for Dominic Santiago — Campaign Gears of War 2, costume id dom_skin_03.
Target edition: Gears of War 2, original Xbox 360 (2008), ordinary campaign C.O.G. armor. The reference image is a front/back preview of the extracted Gears of War 2 model (Models Resource asset 296746), so copy its version-specific silhouette and outfit rather than a later remake. These are two views of the SAME man; output exactly ONE full-body figure. His face has short cropped dark hair and a short dark goatee, not the long beard of Gears 3.
Match the game model: bulky scuffed dark blue-gray COG armor with circular breast structures and the narrow central plate, high layered collar, blue circular shoulder light, chest-mounted long vertical holster/strap on his right chest, short cloth sleeves above the exposed muscular forearms, massive dark plated bracers, fingerless tactical gloves, broad heavy belt and pouch-covered skirt-like hip panels, dusty gray camouflage cargo trousers, dark broad ribbed knee/shin armor with rounded upper panels, thick worn gray-brown armored boots. Match the heavy stocky proportions. The reference is low resolution: keep small seam work, scratches and glyphs restrained instead of inventing large new insignia. No Gears 3 sleeveless cuirass, no long beard, no Judgment or Gears 5 variant.
Pose: neutral motionless full-body standing, front three-quarter facing screen RIGHT; nose and toes pointing right, both relaxed empty hands visible at his sides. No weapon in hand, no action, no animation. Use one complete subject.
Composition: whole figure including hair and boot soles, scaled down to 75% of image height; leave at least 10% transparent margin above, below and beside all body parts.
Realistic game character materials, faithful original outfit proportions, soft readable studio lighting, genuine transparent alpha background. No environment, floor plane, colored backdrop, smoke, halo, shadow cloud, labels, UI, watermark or added text.
